annex_vii_version: Regulation (EU) 2023/1542, Annex VII, consolidated version of 31 July 2025
data_credit: Data: Figgener, J. et al., Data for: Multi-year field measurements of home storage systems and their use in capacity estimation, Zenodo (2024), https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.12091223, licence CC BY 4.0.

fields.label: remaining capacity between a full and an empty rest at two stated relaxed voltages (the record gives both); not the charge between the BMS stops
fields.method: capacity between full and empty rests by coulomb counting, fitted with the offset current and the relaxed voltage of each rest (Figgener et al., Nature Energy 9, 1438 (2024), doi:10.1038/s41560-024-01620-9); read at the mean full and empty rest voltages of the memory time, which the record gives
fields.status: not possible from this data: the empty level has reached the full level, so full and empty no longer mark the two ends of the charge window

details.power_capability_w_status: not possible from this data: no resistance at the date (A5: the current steps near 25 °C give a resistance at or below zero)
details.what_it_is: the resistance on the first day divided by the resistance at the date: the share of the first day's power that the same voltage limits allow now, if the resistance alone limits the power

fields.field: where possible, the remaining power capability
fields.label: power capability share, derived from the 1-second resistance, not measured
fields.method: ratio of the resistance on the first day to the resistance at the date, from dV/dI of current steps between consecutive samples (Barai et al., Sci. Rep. 8, 21 (2018), doi:10.1038/s41598-017-18424-5; Schweiger et al., Sensors 10, 5604 (2010), doi:10.3390/s100605604); no power test
fields.status: not possible from this data: no resistance at the date (A5: the current steps near 25 °C give a resistance at or below zero)

empty_loops.status: not possible from this data: too few closed loops

details.limits: DC at the battery terminals, not the AC efficiency of the plant; depends on the use (Schimpe et al., Applied Energy 210, 211 (2018), doi:10.1016/j.apenergy.2017.10.129); the band holds the ratio over these loops, not the efficiency under other use; a change of the loops' own efficiency within two loops makes the band too narrow; below one degree of freedom there is no band; the energy in also restores the charge the meter does not see; the band holds no zero offset of the current sensor

fields.field: where possible, the remaining round trip efficiency
fields.label: round-trip efficiency (DC, at the battery terminals) over full-to-full loops
fields.method: energy out / energy in, summed over closed loops from one full rest to the next (Regulation (EU) 2023/1542, Annex IV (6)); band: how far that ratio can be off because a loop does not end at exactly the state of charge it started from; the size of that error is learnt from the loops themselves (mean lag-2 product of the loop scores minus the mean lag-1 product)
fields.status: not possible from this data: too few closed loops

details.what_it_holds: the charge the battery loses that its meter does not see: cell self-discharge, BMS supply, balancing and the current sensor's zero offset; mostly not cell self-discharge

fields.label: apparent charge loss (an upper bound for self-discharge)
fields.method: minus the offset current of the capacity fit (Figgener et al., Nature Energy 9, 1438 (2024), doi:10.1038/s41560-024-01620-9); band with the current sensor's gain error
fields.status: not possible from this data: the empty level has reached the full level, so full and empty no longer mark the two ends of the charge window

bands.status: not possible from this data: too few current steps near 15 °C
not possible from this data: the current steps near 20 °C give a resistance at or below zero
not possible from this data: the current steps near 25 °C give a resistance at or below zero
not possible from this data: the current steps near 30 °C give a resistance at or below zero
not possible from this data: too few current steps near 35 °C

details.growth_status: not possible from this data: the current steps near 25 °C give a resistance at or below zero
details.what_it_is: the voltage step over the current step between two samples 1 s apart; it depends on that timescale, the state of charge and the temperature, and is not the cell's ohmic resistance alone

fields.label: 1-second resistance, pack temperature band at 25 degrees C
fields.method: dV/dI of current steps between consecutive samples (Barai et al., Sci. Rep. 8, 21 (2018), doi:10.1038/s41598-017-18424-5; Schweiger et al., Sensors 10, 5604 (2010), doi:10.3390/s100605604)
fields.status: not possible from this data: the current steps near 25 °C give a resistance at or below zero

fields.method: measured hours per pack-temperature band and mode; discharges that reached the system's own end-of-discharge level (empty rests); voltage extremes; counts against limits when limits are given
